description: Edit transactions on a manuscript draft with explicit alignments: which entries an edit keeps, shifts, resizes, empties (target: null) or invalidates, and how undo and redo step over them. Shared by Web (lib/manuscript.js applyEditTransaction, lib/workbench-controller.ts) and Windows.
coordinates: Unicode scalar offsets (JavaScript Array.from indexes, Python str indexes). utf16_splice fields are informational; assertions use scalars.
splice_rule: A free edit becomes the minimal splice between the old and new side text: the longest common UTF-16 prefix, backed off one unit when it ends after a high surrogate, then the longest common suffix of the rest, backed off when it starts at a low surrogate; offsets are then counted in scalars.

rules.R1: An entry whose span ends at or before the splice start is kept as is; one that starts at or after the splice end shifts by the length delta, with its text sliced from the new side text.
rules.R2: A splice inside a span (start <= splice start and splice end <= end) resizes it while text remains.
rules.R3: Only the entries a splice crosses (crossed_boundary), whose source text it deletes (source_emptied) or that a target fill matched ambiguously (fill_ambiguous) leave the list; entries before and after them are kept or shifted.
rules.R4: A target span whose text is deleted (an inside edit that leaves nothing, or a pure deletion covering it) becomes target: null; the entry keeps its source anchor and is listed in emptied_targets.
rules.R5: An insertion at a span boundary point is outside the span: at its end the span is kept, at its start it shifts.
rules.R6: An entry whose span an inside edit grows past 2,000 scalars leaves the list alone (span_too_long). Only malformed input reaches fallback_all, which clears every alignment; no case here does.
rules.R7: A direction change clears every explicit alignment to [] (null stays null).
rules.R8: Undo and redo hold at most 50 steps. A one-scalar edit on the same side within 1,200 ms of the last one joins its step, unless the edit invalidates or empties an alignment, which is a step of its own and is never joined; edits on the other side never join. An IME composition is one step judged against the text before it. Undo restores every entry a step invalidated, and the session list of invalidated entries with it; a new edit clears the redo steps.
rules.R9: Saved manuscripts (v1-v4) hold only the kept alignments; the session list of invalidated entries lives in session state, undo steps and the document checkpoint only, never in browser storage.

alignment_notice.all: the edit left none of the previous explicit alignments
alignment_notice.partial: the edit invalidated some entries and kept others
alignment_notice.null: no entry was invalidated (kept, shifted, resized or emptied-target entries only)

transaction_kinds.edit: {side, text}: the side text becomes `text` (a free edit; see splice_rule)
transaction_kinds.splice: {side, start, end, replacement}: scalars start..end of the side text replaced by `replacement`
transaction_kinds.fill: {pair_source, at, insert, core}: `insert` placed at scalar `at` of the target; `core` (absolute, in the new target) becomes the target of the one untranslated entry whose source lies inside pair_source
